name: ACCESS Job Reporting
description: Reports TAPIS job metadata to the ACCESS-CI Allocations API.
project_description:
ACCESS Job Reporting integrates TAPIS-driven Drupal sites with the ACCESS-CI Allocations API , keeping job metadata synchronized.

 
 Bridges TAPIS job data to ACCESS-CI using a Queue API worker that manages backoff retries and logs responses for traceability. 
 Offers configuration at admin/config/access/job-reporting for XA-API key (with Key module support), XA-AGENT header, endpoint URL, retry interval, max attempts, and debug (dry-run) mode.
